question: A man driving a car at a speed of 84 km/hr crosses a bridge in 1.6 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the speed directly into km/min for a faster direct calculation.

Speed = 84 km/hr = 84 ÷ 60 km/min = 1.4 km/min

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 1.4 × 1.6 = 2.24 km

**∴ The correct answer is 2.24 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 84 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 1.6 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 

 Speed = 84 km/hr
 Time = 1.6 mins
 Bridge Length = ?

**Calculation:**

⇒ First, convert the given time into hours to match the speed unit.

⇒ Time = 1.6 ÷ 60 hours

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 84 × (1.6 ÷ 60)

⇒ Distance = (84 ÷ 60) × 1.6

⇒ Distance = 1.4 × 1.6

⇒ Distance = 2.24 km

Since the length of the car is not provided, we consider it negligible compared to the massive length of the bridge.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.24 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. Conversely, to convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Crossing Objects with Length

When a moving object of length L₁ crosses a stationary object of length L₂ (like a bridge or platform), the total distance covered equals L₁ + L₂.

Average Speed

When an object travels equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed is given by (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).
